items.reason: A is a printed Official unit (Mayor's Majordomo, traits: Official). B says 'While you control another Official unit, this unit gains Raid 2', so A satisfies B's trait condition.
A is a printed Force unit (Zuckuss, traits: Force, Bounty Hunter). B says 'If you control a Force unit, draw a card', which A satisfies.

A is a Piloting unit (Darth Vader, keyword Piloting, 'Piloting [3 resources...]'), so it can attach as an upgrade. B says 'This unit gets +1/+0 for each upgrade on other friendly units', and an attached Vader counts while on another friendly Vehicle.
A says 'you may attack with a ground unit' and B is a Ground unit whose text says 'When this unit attacks and defeats a unit', so each extra attack fires that trigger.

A says 'Each player chooses a unit they control. Deal 3 damage to each chosen unit', so the active player may damage their own unit. B (Asajj Ventress) has Grit, which the row says switches on when damaged.
A says 'If it has the chosen aspect, create a Credit token', so A produces Credit tokens. B says 'Defeat any number of friendly Credit tokens', which spends them.
A is a printed Vehicle unit (AT-DP Occupier, traits: Imperial, Vehicle, Walker). B says 'Each friendly Vehicle unit gets +1/+0 and gains Overwhelm', which A satisfies.

A says 'Defeat a unit with power and remaining HP both equal to the number of ready resources you control', which names any unit, not a friendly one, and only works when that stat match holds. The 'on demand' sacrifice outlet in the reason is not supported by this text.

A says 'If you do, create an X-Wing token', adding a friendly unit. B says 'While you control 2 or more units, ignore the aspect penalties on Heroism units you play', so the token helps reach 2 units.

A says 'Create a Beast token and ready it', which readies a new token, not Luthen Rael. B's only text is 'On Attack: Search the top 5 cards...' and it gains no extra attack or re-activation from this readying.
A is a printed Force unit (Ben Solo, traits: Force). B says 'While you control a Force unit or a Force upgrade, this unit gets +1/+1', which A satisfies.

A says 'ready a friendly unit in the same arena with power equal to or less than that enemy unit', which can ready Adept of Anger (power 1, Ground). B's 'Action [Exhaust, use the Force...]' can then be used again, with its Force token cost paid by the player.

A says 'Deal 1 damage to each of up to 3 different ground units', and the player chooses those targets, so friendly ground units may be damaged. B says 'When a friendly unit is dealt damage and survives: Deal 1 damage to any number of bases'.

A says 'Attack with a unit', which can be Cassian Andor. Cassian's epic action gives the attached unit 'On Attack: Discard a card from the defending player's deck...', which fires on the extra attack.

A is a printed Vehicle unit (Qui-Gon Jinn's Aethersprite, traits: Vehicle). B says 'Flip this leader and attach him as an upgrade to a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it', which A satisfies when it has no Pilot.

A says 'If attached unit is a Transport, you may create a Spy token', so the token depends on a Transport and a Spy has no Raid. B says 'Each friendly unit's Raid is doubled', and the 'wide-board' want comes only from 'curated cur-0063', not from B's text.
A says 'Return a non-leader unit with 6 or more power to its owner's hand', but Dragonboat Freighter has power 5, so A cannot return B. The replay benefit therefore cannot be reached through A.

A says 'Choose a unit. For this phase, it gains Sentinel and: When this unit is attacked: Create a Spy token', so the Spy appears only if the chosen unit is attacked in that phase. The text does not settle whether this happens before The Marauder is played, so the cost-reduction benefit cannot be confirmed.

A says 'Give a Shield token to a unit', and it can target a friendly unit other than Executor. The row's reason treats Shield tokens as upgrades, and B says 'This unit gets +1/+0 for each upgrade on other friendly units'.

A says 'Give 2 Experience tokens to a unit, then deal 2 damage to it', and the target may be a friendly unit. B (Pong Krell) has Grit and can be damaged, and B's 'When this unit completes an attack (and survives)' fits.
A is a printed Vehicle unit (Chimaera, traits: Vehicle). B's 'Epic Action' says 'This upgrade can be played on a friendly Vehicle unit with a Pilot on it', so A qualifies once it has a Pilot.

A says 'When you take the initiative: You may attack with a unit', and that unit may be Qui-Gon Jinn. B's deployBox says 'When this unit completes an attack (and survives)', which the extra attack triggers.

A says 'If you control an Endor base, you may attack with a unit. It gets +2/+0 for this attack', which needs an Endor base under your control. B (Rickety Quadjumper) says 'On Attack: You may reveal the top card...', which fires on the extra attack.

A says 'You may deal 2 damage to a unit', and the target may be your own unit. B (Qui-Gon Jinn) has Grit, which needs a damaged unit, and its When Played 'may defeat a unit that attacked your base this phase'.

A says 'Attack with a unit', which can be Jar Jar Binks. Jar Jar's deployBox says 'On Attack: If you gave a token upgrade to a unit this phase, you may...', so the extra attack fires that On Attack trigger, though its payoff needs a token upgrade that A does not supply.
